description: The Open Type font file package needed to read otf, ttf, and ttc files.
releaseNotes:
9.12.0-beta.1
Version aligned with Scryber.Core 9.12.0-beta.1.
Fixed: MeasureLine took the left side bearing of the first glyph off the width of every run it measured (TTFStringMeasurer, and both measuring methods in TrueTypeFile). Text is drawn from the glyph origin, so each run was measured short by that bearing and the run after it on a line was placed over its end - the space before a bound value, a span or a change of font all but disappeared ("Period up to30 September"). The full advance width is now measured, as browsers do. Lines are about 0.5 to 2 points wider, so a line can now break one word earlier than before.

9.11.0
Version aligned with Scryber.Core 9.11.0.
New: the package has a readme, with examples of reading, measuring and subsetting fonts.
New: FontSubsetter creates a subset of a TrueType font with only the outlines of the glyphs used (by glyph number, which are kept the same), to embed a smaller font in a document. Glyph 0 and the components of composite glyphs are kept, only the tables needed to draw the glyphs are written (no layout tables, post without glyph names, long loca), and the checksums are set. A CFF font, a collection, or a font whose licence does not allow subsetting (fsType 0x0100) is not subset, with the reason.

9.7.5
Fixed: the data of a font from a collection (.ttc or .otc) was the collection from the font header to the end of the file, with offsets from the start of the collection, so it was not a valid font program. A PDF viewer could not load the embedded font and drew another one. The font is now rebuilt on its own.
New: targets net8.0, net9.0 and net10.0 as well as net6.0 and netstandard2.0.
New: ResourceStreamLoader reads a font from an assembly resource (rsrc://Namespace.File.ext, AssemblyName).

9.7.4
Fixed a data race in TTFStringMeasurer's per-character glyph metric cache: a shared measurer written from multiple threads at once (concurrent document rendering) could corrupt the underlying Dictionary, surfacing as InvalidOperationException/ArgumentException/NullReferenceException out of MeasureChars. Cache is now a ConcurrentDictionary, written through the indexer.
Versioning aligned with the Scryber.Core engine version from this release onward - the PackageVersion had drifted from what was actually last published (9.2.0) since 6.0.3.3-beta; the source itself was current, only the project file's version metadata had lagged.

9.2.0
Now supports the otf, ttf, and ttc file formats for font reading and measuring.
Compatible with net standard 2.0 and net 6.0.

There is a change in usage to the Scryber.OpenType.TypefaceReader along with returning a LineSize struct, rather than a System.Drawing.SizeF struct.

Added support for measurement honoring the non-breaking space (char 160) and breaking preferentially on a hypen if it is flagged in the type measurement options.

This is the base type for reading OpenType, TTF and TTC font files used in scryber.core, but is independent from any PDF creation requirements.

See the read me at https://github.com/richard-scryber/Scryber.Core.OpenType for more usage information.
title: Scryber.Core.OpenType
